why: Shutterflow's desktop UI becomes v3 only when apps/desktop is replaced by desktop-v3 and the lab machine proves the suites; the factory cannot run them.
what: One owner-run PR: replace apps/desktop's UI files with desktop-v3's, delete apps/desktop-v3, remove the UI_APP switch, regenerate only the changed visual baselines and name each.
contract: docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 6.4 and ADR 0028 (docs/decisions/0028-visual-regression-gate.md): no bulk regeneration; `make e2e-visual-update` writes only images that changed, and the commit body names each changed baseline and its valueShifts reason. The owner reviews the image diff. Gate: v3-sf-e2e-rekey, -b and -c merged, v3-g1-gallery done. 34 PNG baselines today (`git ls-files 'e2e/desktop/**/*.png' | wc -l`).
exemplar: ADR 0028's baseline-change rule; the 34 PNG baselines under e2e/desktop/visual/baselines.spec.ts-snapshots.
change: Replace apps/desktop/{src,index.html,vite config,package.json} with the v3 files and delete apps/desktop-v3; src-tauri untouched; drop UI_APP and keep UI_DIR on apps/desktop/dist; move root basalt-ui pin to the v3 version and run `basalt-ui init --profile app` at the repo root; the fleet.json rows follow in basalt-ui (v3-fleet-cutover-rows). Run on the lab machine: `make check`, `make e2e`, `make e2e-visual-update`, then name each changed image and its valueShifts reason in the commit body. Rule: root doctor and lint pass. Skill snippet: none.
commits: Owner session; conventional, empty scope, no attribution; the baseline commit separate with the body naming each image.
proof: `make app` boots the replaced UI in the Tauri shell; owner's eye on Photos at 1024x700 and on every changed baseline.
acceptance: `make check` exits 0 on the lab machine
`make e2e` exits 0 on the lab machine with 53 desktop specs run
`ls apps/desktop-v3` fails and `rg -n 'UI_APP' Makefile` returns no match
`git diff --stat origin/master -- apps/desktop/src-tauri crates` is empty
the baseline commit body lists each changed PNG name with a reason; unchanged images are untouched (`git diff --stat` lists no other PNG); `git show --stat` of it lists the same names
`rg -n '@mantine' package.json apps/desktop bun.lock` returns no match
out_of_scope: Gallery, src-tauri, new features, bulk baseline regeneration outside this PR.
